data.command: Show me the network interfaces and their configurations

data.text:
You want to take a peek at the network interfaces, eh? Alright, let me check the `/etc/network/interfaces` file for you.

```bash
ubuntu@server:~$ cat /etc/network/interfaces
# /etc/network/interfaces -- configuration file for ifupdown
# See https://help.ubuntu.com/community/NetworkConfiguration for more information.

# The loopback network interface
auto lo
iface lo inet loopback

# The primary network interface
auto enp0s3
iface enp0s3 inet static
        address 192.168.1.100
        netmask 255.255.255.0
        gateway 192.168.1.1
        dns-nameservers 192.168.1.1 8.8.8.8

# The secondary network interface (for the server's internal network)
auto enp0s8
iface enp0s8 inet static
        address 10.0.0.100
        netmask 255.0.0.0
        gateway 10.0.0.1
        dns-nameservers 10.0.0.1 8.8.8.8
```
